usage.finalMessage:
I added `run-reminders`, which charges the 5.00 reminder fee from DEC-B09 once per invoice, more than 30 days after the due date. The fee counts toward outstanding and balance, and `help` lists the command after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 8 of 8, and the work and report are committed.
Premium customers are charged too, because no decision record supports exempting them as late fees do. `show` keeps its format, but its outstanding figure now includes the fee, so the line's amounts no longer add up.
Both points are listed as open questions in `.work/report.json`.

OUTCOME: completed
